slides.title: Why join
slides.body: AI can generate frontend or backend code, but full-stack work fails when the parts drift apart.

slides.title: What we will cover
slides.body: How to use AI tools from product spec to deployed full-stack app.

slides.title: For the cohort
slides.body: Use this session to prepare for AI Dev Tools Zoomcamp 2026 and the final project.

slides.title: Bring questions
slides.body: There will be time for practical questions about tools, workflow, review, testing, and shipping.
